articles.title: Eraaya Lifespaces renamed as Ebix Limited to align with global brand
articles.description: Eraaya Lifespaces Limited has officially changed its name to Ebix Limited after receiving approval from the Ministry of Corporate Affairs. The company operates across technology, payments, travel, and emerging businesses in 13 countries.

articles.title: ideaForge Technology seeks ₹5,000 crore fund raising via postal ballot
articles.description: ideaForge Technology Limited has scheduled a postal ballot to seek shareholder approval for raising up to ₹5,000 million through various securities, including equity shares and debentures. The e-voting period is open from June 5, 2026, to July 4, 2026, with a cut-off date of May 29, 2026. Additionally, the company proposes amending its Articles of Association to align the definition of "Promoter" with SEBI ICDR Regulations.
